verified_facts.text: The price of cooking oil from Harbourline Dry Goods Pte Ltd increased by 17.8% from April to September 2026, from S$3.700 to S$4.360 per liter [E1].
From April to July 2026, the global price of palm oil decreased by 1.6% and soybean oil increased by 7.7% in SGD terms [E2, E3].
The price increase from April to July 2026 was 7.6%, which is 4 percentage points higher than the market average of 3.1% during the same period [E4].

possible_explanations.text: The initial 7.6% price increase could be due to market factors, but the additional 9.5% increase after July 2026 is not supported by available market data [E4].
